steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the event type from the default to RFQ.
Apply an RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the first requested product with quantity 10.
Set the first row's delivery location.
Confirm the first product row contains the requested product.
Confirm the product's variant is filled automatically.

Confirm the sheet now contains two product rows.
Confirm the second row contains AAC BLOCKS.
Confirm the second row's variant is populated.
Confirm the second row has its own quantity.
Confirm the second row has its own location.
